note: How the minimap and the full map tint the sewer's water. The water cells are the ones the swim, slip and landing code read (the sewer chunk grid's WATER code); a discovered water cell is drawn as the floor colour with this tint laid over it. fill is #rrggbb and strength is 0..1 (how far the floor colour moves toward fill: 0 shows no water, 1 a flat blue). legend is the word the full map's legend shows for it, in capitals; the colour name in it should match fill.

reveal._note: How far the runner sees the floor for the map (Godot FacilityMap reveal), in cells; the cells must also be in line of sight. Level 0 uses it like the sewer and the Inferno.
